title: A Postcards for the Undertow
author: Bram Montrose
blurb: Astrid Quintana, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent fifteen years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the house sale closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
